purpose: Decompose the confirmed positive evolving-minus-fixed isolation interaction into arm-specific evolutionary effects without rerunning or retuning the biological campaign.
matching_rule: For every arm-specific contrast, use only demographic repeats for which fixed-near, fixed-far, evolving-near and evolving-far are all occupied. Average repeats within visitor history before any across-history summary.

estimands.arm_investment_change: For each mode x arm, terminal investment minus its matched founder value.
estimands.arm_assurance_change: For each mode x arm, terminal assurance minus its matched founder value.
estimands.evolution_effect_within_arm: evolving investment change minus fixed investment change within the same arm.
estimands.attenuation_identity: (evolving far - evolving near) - (fixed far - fixed near) = evolution_effect_far - evolution_effect_near

interpretation_rules.near_driven: evolution_effect_near is more negative than evolution_effect_far; attenuation is produced primarily by additional investment decline in the high-supply arm.
interpretation_rules.far_relief: evolution_effect_far is positive relative to fixed while near is unchanged or less affected; attenuation is produced primarily by weaker decline in the low-supply arm.
interpretation_rules.mixed: both arm-specific changes materially contribute; report both rather than forcing a single mediation label.
interpretation_rules.no_mediation_fraction: This algebra localizes the interaction but is not a natural direct/indirect effect decomposition.

mechanistic_anchor.scope: Corrected fixed-resident rare-mutant gradients under the four baseline reproductive settings.
mechanistic_anchor.preexisting_result: Across the 60 baseline setting-community-matching fields (144060 resident states), the capacity effect on investment selection is negative throughout; this is a local selection diagnostic, not proof of trajectory mediation.
mechanistic_anchor.sensitivity_boundary: The broader 500-combination parameter diagnostic contains 25 positive cross-effect exceptions, so the negative coupling is not universal outside the declared baseline settings.

reporting.all_four: Report every setting regardless of direction.
reporting.no_new_journal_gate: This decomposition explains the already confirmed interaction and does not alter the frozen journal-routing adjudication.
reporting.no_new_simulation: Reuse only hash-verified raw artifacts from source workflow run 37458098483.
